instruction: Candid documentary photograph, wide shot, slightly high angle. In an indoor motion capture studio with a red carpet and white walls, the man in the black polo and blue shorts (R1) stands on the left, balancing on his right leg as he kicks his left leg high forward. The woman in the white t-shirt and blue jeans (R2) stands on the right, facing away from the camera and looking toward him. R1's extended foot reaches toward R2's hip level in a controlled kick. Overhead artificial lights illuminate the scene, casting soft shadows on the red carpet.
